series.name: InfiniSolar VII / Infinity Infini VII (2/3/5/6KW hybrid)
series.notes: Voltronic InfiniSolar VII OEM manual (no Tesla badge in PDF) — medium via Tesla Infinity 6kW Scribd listing + Maxsolar Tesla brochure. Includes parallel codes 60/71/72/73/80–86. Warnings are W-prefixed (W01–W19) to avoid fault-code collision.

meaning.ur: Cooling fan atka.

causes.en: See manual
causes.ur: Manual dekhein

causes.en: Cooling fan blocked by dust or a foreign object
causes.ur: Cooling fan mein dhag ya bahir ki koi cheez atki hui hai

causes.en: Fan wiring open or fan motor seized
causes.ur: Pankha ki wiring khuli hai ya fan motor ne jam kar diya hai

solutions.en: Power off and isolate AC and DC supply before touching the cooling fan.
solutions.ur: Power band karein aur cooling fan chune se pehle AC aur DC supply alag kar lein.

solutions.en: Spin the cooling fan by hand and check its connector for loose pins or burnt marks.
solutions.ur: Cooling fan haath se ghuma kar dekhein aur uske connector par dhile pin ya jalne ke nishaan check karein.

solutions.en: Clean the fan and heatsink; if the fan still does not spin free or the motor reads open on a meter, replace it and retest after restoring supply.
solutions.ur: Fan aur heatsink saaf karein; phir bhi fan azaad na ghoomay ya meter par motor open aaye to fan badlein aur supply wapas lagane ke baad dobara check karein.

source.title: Hybrid 2/3/5/6KW InfiniSolar VII-class manual (ivii_wb — no Tesla badge; Tesla Infinity 6kW Scribd listing)

meaning.ur: Converter zyada garm ho gaya.

causes.en: See manual
causes.ur: Manual dekhein

causes.en: Cooling fan slow or heatsink choked with dust
causes.ur: Cooling fan slow chal raha hai ya heatsink dhag se band hai

causes.en: Heavy load or hot ambient for a long time raised temperature
causes.ur: Lambi der tak zyada load ya garam mausam ki wajah se garmi barh gayi

solutions.en: Turn the unit off and let it cool down, keeping AC supply isolated while you check.
solutions.ur: Unit band kar dein aur thanda hone dein, jab tak check karein AC supply alag hi rakhein.

solutions.en: Clean dust from the heatsink, confirm the cooling fan runs and the air vents are not blocked.
solutions.ur: Heatsink se dhag saaf karein, cooling fan chal raha hai aur vents band nahi hain yeh confirm karein.

solutions.en: If the fan or sensor fails on test, replace it; avoid heavy load until temperature is normal, then restart and retest.
solutions.ur: Test mein fan ya sensor kharab mile to badlein; temperature normal hone tak zyada load na dein, phir restart karke dobara check karein.

source.title: Hybrid 2/3/5/6KW InfiniSolar VII-class manual (ivii_wb — no Tesla badge; Tesla Infinity 6kW Scribd listing)

meaning.ur: Battery zyada charge ho gayi.

causes.en: See manual
causes.ur: Manual dekhein

causes.en: Charger float/absorption voltage set too high for this battery
causes.ur: Charger ka float/absorption voltage is battery ke liye bohat zyada set hai

causes.en: Battery sulphated or charger not cutting off at full charge
causes.ur: Battery sulphated ho gayi ya charger full charge par cut-off nahi kar raha

solutions.en: Stop charging now — switch off the inverter and isolate AC supply, and keep batteries away from sparks.
solutions.ur: Abhi charging band karein — inverter off karein aur AC supply alag kar lein, battery ke paas spark na dein.

solutions.en: Measure battery voltage with a meter and compare it with the charger float/absorption setting in the menu.
solutions.ur: Battery ka voltage meter se naapein aur menu mein charger ki float/absorption setting se compare karein.

solutions.en: If charger output is too high or a battery cell is dead, have the charger or battery checked and replaced, then retest.
solutions.ur: Charger ka output bohat zyada hai ya koi cell dead hai to charger ya battery check ya replace karwayein, phir dobara check karein.

source.title: Hybrid 2/3/5/6KW InfiniSolar VII-class manual (ivii_wb — no Tesla badge; Tesla Infinity 6kW Scribd listing)

meaning.ur: Battery cut-off se neeche.

causes.en: See manual
causes.ur: Manual dekhein

causes.en: Battery deeply discharged or old and weak
causes.ur: Battery bilkul discharge ho gayi hai ya purani aur kamzor hai

causes.en: Loose battery terminals or thin long cables causing voltage drop
causes.ur: Battery ke terminal dhile hain ya patli lambi taar ki wajah se voltage gir raha hai

solutions.en: Switch off the inverter and isolate DC before checking any battery wiring.
solutions.ur: Battery wiring check karne se pehle inverter band karein aur DC alag kar lein.

solutions.en: Measure battery resting voltage with a meter and tighten and clean the terminals and cable lugs.
solutions.ur: Battery ka resting voltage meter se naapein aur terminal/cable lugs ko kassi kar saaf karein.

solutions.en: Charge the batteries from a known supply; if an old battery will not hold charge, replace it and retest.
solutions.ur: Battery ko kisi ache source se charge karein; purani battery charge na rok sake to badal kar dobara check karein.

source.title: Hybrid 2/3/5/6KW InfiniSolar VII-class manual (ivii_wb — no Tesla badge; Tesla Infinity 6kW Scribd listing)

meaning.ur: AC output short.

causes.en: See manual
causes.ur: Manual dekhein

causes.en: Output wiring shorted to neutral or to body earth
causes.ur: Output ki taar neutral ya body earth se short ho gayi hai

causes.en: Connected load has an internal short or is wet/damaged
causes.ur: Lage hue load ke andar short hai ya woh geela/kharab hai

solutions.en: Switch off the inverter and isolate AC supply before touching any output wiring.
solutions.ur: Output ki taar chune se pehle inverter band karein aur AC supply alag kar lein.

solutions.en: Disconnect the load and use a meter to check the output wiring for a short to neutral or body earth.
solutions.ur: Load utaar kar meter se output wiring ka neutral ya body earth ke saath short check karein.

solutions.en: Repair the shorted wiring or replace the faulty appliance, then restore supply and confirm normal output on the meter.
solutions.ur: Short wali wiring theek karein ya kharab appliance badlein, phir supply wapas laga kar meter par output normal hai yeh confirm karein.

source.title: Hybrid 2/3/5/6KW InfiniSolar VII-class manual (ivii_wb — no Tesla badge; Tesla Infinity 6kW Scribd listing)

meaning.ur: Output window se bahar.

causes.en: See manual
causes.ur: Manual dekhein

causes.en: Voltage sense/feedback path on the PCB faulty
causes.ur: PCB par voltage sense ya feedback path kharab hai

causes.en: Unbalanced load or loose output wiring
causes.ur: Load barabar nahi hai ya output ki wiring dhili hai

solutions.en: Power off and isolate AC and DC supply before probing the output.
solutions.ur: Output check karne se pehle power band karein aur AC aur DC supply alag kar lein.

solutions.en: Measure the output voltage and confirm the load is balanced and the output wiring is tight.
solutions.ur: Output voltage naapein aur load barabar hai aur output wiring kassi hai yeh confirm karein.

solutions.en: Correct the wiring or load; if the reading still wanders outside the window, have the voltage sense circuit on the PCB checked.
solutions.ur: Wiring ya load theek karein; reading phir bhi window ke bahar jaati rahe to PCB par voltage sense circuit check karwayein.

source.title: Hybrid 2/3/5/6KW InfiniSolar VII-class manual (ivii_wb — no Tesla badge; Tesla Infinity 6kW Scribd listing)

title.ur: Load zyada rehne par time out

meaning.ur: Load ≥110% timer khatam.

causes.en: See manual
causes.ur: Manual dekhein

causes.en: Connected load more than the inverter rating
causes.ur: Laga hua load inverter ki rating se zyada hai

causes.en: Motor or compressor drawing high starting current
causes.ur: Motor ya compressor start par bohat zyada current le raha hai

solutions.en: Turn off the inverter and isolate AC supply, then disconnect heavy loads.
solutions.ur: Inverter band karein, AC supply alag kar dein aur bhaari load utaar dein.

solutions.en: Compare the total connected load with the inverter rating and remove extra appliances one by one.
solutions.ur: Kul load ko inverter ki rating se compare karein aur ek ek karke extra appliances utaarte jayein.

solutions.en: Start again only when the load is within rating; if a motor draws high starting current, reduce the load or have the unit checked.
solutions.ur: Load rating ke andar ho tabhi dobara on karein; motor zyada starting current le raha hai to load kam karein ya unit check karwayein.

source.title: Hybrid 2/3/5/6KW InfiniSolar VII-class manual (ivii_wb — no Tesla badge; Tesla Infinity 6kW Scribd listing)

meaning.ur: DC bus par voltage zyada ho gaya.

causes.en: See manual
causes.ur: Manual dekhein

causes.en: High PV input or grid feed pushing the bus voltage up
causes.ur: PV input ya grid se zyada aane par bus voltage barh gaya

causes.en: Load suddenly removed while the bus was charging
causes.ur: Bus charge hote waqt load achanak hat gaya

solutions.en: Power off and isolate AC and DC supply before probing the DC bus.
solutions.ur: DC bus check karne se pehle power band karein aur AC aur DC dono alag kar lein.

solutions.en: Let the bus discharge, then measure PV input and battery voltage and check the settings for high PV input.
solutions.ur: Bus ko discharge hone dein, phir PV input aur battery voltage naapein aur setting mein zyada PV input check karein.

solutions.en: Bring PV input within the limit or fix the load-dump situation, then power up and confirm the code clears.
solutions.ur: PV input limit ke andar karein ya load achanak hatne ki situation theek karein, phir power on karke code khatam hua yeh dekhein.

source.title: Hybrid 2/3/5/6KW InfiniSolar VII-class manual (ivii_wb — no Tesla badge; Tesla Infinity 6kW Scribd listing)

meaning.ur: Soft-start fail.

causes.en: See manual
causes.ur: Manual dekhein

causes.en: DC bus not reaching start voltage — weak battery or high load
causes.ur: DC bus ka start voltage nahi ban raha — battery kamzor hai ya load zyada hai

causes.en: Pre-charge circuit or main relay faulty
causes.ur: Pre-charge circuit ya main relay kharab hai

solutions.en: Power off and isolate AC and DC supply before any further testing.
solutions.ur: Aage koi bhi test karne se pehle power band karein aur AC aur DC dono alag kar lein.

solutions.en: Measure battery and DC bus voltage at power-on and check the pre-charge circuit and main relay.
solutions.ur: On karte waqt battery aur DC bus voltage naapein aur pre-charge circuit aur main relay check karein.

solutions.en: Charge or replace a weak battery and repair the pre-charge circuit or relay if faulty, then power up and confirm soft start completes.
solutions.ur: Kamzor battery charge ya replace karein aur kharab pre-charge circuit ya relay theek karein, phir power on karke soft start mukammal hua yeh confirm karein.

source.title: Hybrid 2/3/5/6KW InfiniSolar VII-class manual (ivii_wb — no Tesla badge; Tesla Infinity 6kW Scribd listing)

meaning.ur: PV input ka current zyada hai.

causes.en: See manual
causes.ur: Manual dekhein

causes.en: PV strings paralleled beyond the input rating
causes.ur: PV strings input rating se zyada parallel kar di gayi hain

causes.en: PV input wiring shorted or MPPT stage faulty
causes.ur: PV input ki taaron mein short hai ya MPPT stage kharab hai

solutions.en: Isolate the PV supply (cover the panels or open the PV breaker) before opening the inverter.
solutions.ur: Inverter kholne se pehle PV supply alag karein (panels par cover lagayein ya PV breaker kholein).

solutions.en: Count the parallel strings against the input rating and meter-check PV current and wiring for a short.
solutions.ur: Parallel strings ko input rating se compare karein aur PV current aur wiring ka short meter se check karein.

solutions.en: Reduce the strings within rating or repair shorted wiring; if the fault remains, have the MPPT input stage checked.
solutions.ur: Strings rating ke andar karein ya short wali wiring theek karein; fault rahe to MPPT input stage check karwayein.

source.title: Hybrid 2/3/5/6KW InfiniSolar VII-class manual (ivii_wb — no Tesla badge; Tesla Infinity 6kW Scribd listing)

meaning.ur: String Voc zyada.

causes.en: See manual
causes.ur: Manual dekhein

causes.en: String open-circuit voltage above the inverter limit
causes.ur: String ka open-circuit voltage inverter ki limit se zyada hai

causes.en: Too many panels in series for this model
causes.ur: Is model ke liye series mein bohat zyada panels lage hue hain

solutions.en: Isolate the PV supply and cover the panels before checking string wiring.
solutions.ur: String wiring check karne se pehle PV supply alag karein aur panels par cover lagayein.

solutions.en: Measure string open-circuit voltage with a meter and compare it with the inverter limit given in the manual.
solutions.ur: String ka open-circuit voltage meter se naapein aur manual mein di gayi inverter limit se compare karein.

solutions.en: Reduce panels in series to within the limit; if voltage still reads high, check the PV input sensing before powering up.
solutions.ur: Series mein panels limit ke andar karein; voltage phir bhi zyada aaye to power on karne se pehle PV input sensing check karein.

source.title: Hybrid 2/3/5/6KW InfiniSolar VII-class manual (ivii_wb — no Tesla badge; Tesla Infinity 6kW Scribd listing)

meaning.ur: Battery charge ka current zyada ho gaya.

causes.en: See manual
causes.ur: Manual dekhein

causes.en: Charge current limit set too high in the settings
causes.ur: Setting mein charge current limit bohat zyada set hai

causes.en: Weak battery pulling too much current or charger stage faulty
causes.ur: Kamzor battery bohat zyada current le raha hai ya charger ka stage kharab hai

solutions.en: Power off and isolate AC and DC before probing the charging path.
solutions.ur: Charging wala rasta check karne se pehle power band karein aur AC aur DC alag kar lein.

solutions.en: Check the charge current limit in the settings and measure the actual charging current with a clamp or meter.
solutions.ur: Setting mein charge current limit check karein aur asal charging current clamp ya meter se naapein.

solutions.en: If current stays high with a healthy battery, have the charging stage on the PCB checked or repaired, then retest.
solutions.ur: Achi battery ke baad bhi current zyada rahe to PCB ka charging stage check ya repair karwayein, phir dobara check karein.

source.title: Hybrid 2/3/5/6KW InfiniSolar VII-class manual (ivii_wb — no Tesla badge; Tesla Infinity 6kW Scribd listing)

meaning.ur: Current zyada ya surge aane se trip ho gaya.

causes.en: See manual
causes.ur: Manual dekhein

causes.en: Load inrush or surge higher than the set limit
causes.ur: Load ka inrush ya surge set limit se zyada tha

causes.en: Current sensor reading high or a short developing on output
causes.ur: Current sensor zyada reading de raha hai ya output mein short ban raha hai

solutions.en: Power off and isolate AC and DC supply before any further testing.
solutions.ur: Aage koi bhi test karne se pehle power band karein aur AC aur DC dono alag kar lein.

solutions.en: Disconnect the load, check the output wiring for a short and measure current with a meter when restarting.
solutions.ur: Load utaar kar output wiring mein short check karein aur restart par current meter se naapein.

solutions.en: Remove the overloaded or shorted load or repair the wiring; if the trip repeats with no load, have the power section checked.
solutions.ur: Zyada load ya short wala load utaarein ya wiring theek karein; load ke bawajood trip dobara ho to power section check karwayein.

source.title: Hybrid 2/3/5/6KW InfiniSolar VII-class manual (ivii_wb — no Tesla badge; Tesla Infinity 6kW Scribd listing)

meaning.ur: DC bus par voltage kam ho gaya.

causes.en: See manual
causes.ur: Manual dekhein

causes.en: Battery weak/deeply discharged or battery cables loose
causes.ur: Battery kamzor ya discharge hai ya battery taarein dhili hain

causes.en: Input supply missing or pre-charge circuit faulty
causes.ur: Input supply nahi aa rahi ya pre-charge circuit kharab hai

solutions.en: Switch off the unit and isolate supply before checking battery and DC wiring.
solutions.ur: Battery aur DC wiring check karne se pehle unit band karein aur supply alag kar lein.

solutions.en: Measure battery voltage at the inverter terminals and check cable tightness and the fuse.
solutions.ur: Inverter ke terminals par battery voltage naapein aur taaron ki kassi aur fuse check karein.

solutions.en: Charge or replace a weak battery and repair loose or faulty wiring, then power up and retest.
solutions.ur: Kamzor battery charge ya replace karein aur dhili ya kharab wiring theek karein, phir power on karke dobara check karein.

source.title: Hybrid 2/3/5/6KW InfiniSolar VII-class manual (ivii_wb — no Tesla badge; Tesla Infinity 6kW Scribd listing)

meaning.ur: Output soft-start fail.

causes.en: See manual
causes.ur: Manual dekhein

causes.en: Output relay not picking up or its contacts pitted/welded
causes.ur: Output relay pick nahi kar raha ya uske contacts kharab ya chipak gaye hain

causes.en: Load too heavy at switch-on or inverter power section faulty
causes.ur: On karte hi load bohat zyada hai ya inverter ka power section kharab hai

solutions.en: Switch off the inverter and isolate AC and DC supply before checking the output relay.
solutions.ur: Output relay check karne se pehle inverter band karein aur AC aur DC supply alag kar lein.

solutions.en: Listen for the relay click at power-on and check output relay contacts and wiring with a meter.
solutions.ur: On karte waqt relay ki awaaz sunein aur output relay contacts aur wiring meter se check karein.

solutions.en: Replace a stuck relay or repair its drive; if the load was too heavy at start, reduce the load and retest.
solutions.ur: Atka hua relay badlein ya uska drive theek karein; start par load zyada tha to load kam karke dobara check karein.

source.title: Hybrid 2/3/5/6KW InfiniSolar VII-class manual (ivii_wb — no Tesla badge; Tesla Infinity 6kW Scribd listing)

title.en: Over DC offset in AC output
title.ur: AC output mein DC offset zyada

meaning.ur: AC par DC offset.

causes.en: See manual
causes.ur: Manual dekhein

causes.en: Output filter capacitor aged or one inverter leg not switching
causes.ur: Output filter capacitor purana ho gaya hai ya ek inverter leg switch nahi kar raha

causes.en: Current/voltage sense circuit drifting on the PCB
causes.ur: PCB par current/voltage sense circuit drift kar raha hai

solutions.en: Power off and isolate AC and DC supply before probing the output stage.
solutions.ur: Output stage check karne se pehle power band karein aur AC aur DC alag kar lein.

solutions.en: With the load disconnected, meter-measure the DC offset on the AC output and check the filter capacitors.
solutions.ur: Load khud karke AC output par DC offset meter se naapein aur filter capacitors check karein.

solutions.en: Replace aged capacitors or repair the sense and switching circuit, then restore supply and verify the reading is near zero.
solutions.ur: Purane capacitor badlein ya sense aur switching circuit theek karein, phir supply wapas laga kar reading zero ke qareeb hai yeh verify karein.

source.title: Hybrid 2/3/5/6KW InfiniSolar VII-class manual (ivii_wb — no Tesla badge; Tesla Infinity 6kW Scribd listing)

meaning.ur: Battery wires open / fuse jal gaya.

causes.en: See manual
causes.ur: Manual dekhein

causes.en: Main fuse blown or fuse holder burnt
causes.ur: Main fuse jal gaya hai ya fuse holder jal gaya hai

causes.en: Battery cable loose, disconnected or broken at the terminal
causes.ur: Battery ki taar dhili hai, khul gayi hai ya terminal ke paas toot gayi hai

solutions.en: Power off and isolate both AC and DC before touching battery cables or the fuse.
solutions.ur: Battery ki taar ya fuse chune se pehle power band karein aur AC aur DC dono alag kar lein.

solutions.en: Visually check the main fuse and fuse holder, and meter-check battery voltage at the inverter terminals.
solutions.ur: Main fuse aur fuse holder nazar se dekhein aur inverter ke terminals par battery voltage meter se check karein.

solutions.en: Replace a blown fuse with the same rating and repair or retighten loose cables; restore supply and confirm the code clears.
solutions.ur: Fusa fuse ko usi rating ka badlein aur dhili taar theek ya kassi karein; supply wapas laga kar code khatam hua yeh confirm karein.

source.title: Hybrid 2/3/5/6KW InfiniSolar VII-class manual (ivii_wb — no Tesla badge; Tesla Infinity 6kW Scribd listing)

meaning.ur: Current sensor fail.

causes.en: See manual
causes.ur: Manual dekhein

causes.en: Sensor connector loose or sensing wires broken
causes.ur: Sensor ka connector dhila hai ya sensing taarein toot gayi hain

causes.en: CT / current sensor module burnt
causes.ur: CT ya current sensor module jal gaya hai

solutions.en: Switch off the unit and isolate supply before checking the sensor.
solutions.ur: Sensor check karne se pehle unit band karein aur supply alag kar lein.

solutions.en: Check the sensor connector and meter-check the wiring continuity.
solutions.ur: Sensor connector check karein aur wiring ka continuity meter se naapein.

solutions.en: Replace the CT or current sensor if the reading stays invalid, then restore supply and confirm a normal reading.
solutions.ur: Reading theek na aaye to CT ya current sensor badlein, phir supply wapas laga kar reading normal hai yeh confirm karein.

source.title: Hybrid 2/3/5/6KW InfiniSolar VII-class manual (ivii_wb — no Tesla badge; Tesla Infinity 6kW Scribd listing)

meaning.ur: Output window se neeche.

causes.en: See manual
causes.ur: Manual dekhein

causes.en: Heavy load dragging the output voltage down
causes.ur: Zyada load ki wajah se output voltage neeche gir gaya

causes.en: Loose output connections or weak battery/DC supply
causes.ur: Output ke connections dhile hain ya battery/DC supply kamzor hai

solutions.en: Turn off the inverter and isolate supply before checking the load side.
solutions.ur: Load side check karne se pehle inverter band karein aur supply alag kar lein.

solutions.en: Measure output voltage under load and check battery/DC voltage and the output connections.
solutions.ur: Load par output voltage naapein aur battery/DC voltage aur output connections check karein.

solutions.en: Reduce the load or tighten loose connections; if voltage stays low with a good battery, have the inverter power section checked.
solutions.ur: Load kam karein ya dhile connection kassi karein; achi battery ke baad bhi voltage kam rahe to inverter ka power section check karwayein.

causes.ur: Grid aur inverter ka output phase mein alag hai, parallel setting ghalat hai

causes.en: Backup/grid feed present while the inverter is feeding, setup conflict
causes.ur: Inverter feed karte waqt grid/backup bhi aa raha hai, setting mein conflict hai

solutions.en: Switch off all parallel units and isolate AC supply before changing any settings.
solutions.ur: Koi setting badalne se pehle sab parallel units band karein aur AC supply alag kar lein.

solutions.en: Check that feed direction and parallel settings match on every unit in the menu.
solutions.ur: Menu mein feed direction aur parallel setting har unit par same hai yeh check karein.

solutions.en: Correct the settings and parallel wiring, then power up the master first and confirm the fault clears.
solutions.ur: Setting aur parallel wiring theek karein, phir pehle master unit on karke fault khatam hua yeh confirm karein.

source.title: Hybrid 2/3/5/6KW InfiniSolar VII-class manual (ivii_wb — no Tesla badge; Tesla Infinity 6kW Scribd listing)

meaning.ur: Firmware version sab units mein match nahi karta — parallel/setup masla.

causes.en: Parallel/setup
causes.ur: Parallel/setup ka masla — setting match nahi kar rahi

causes.en: Units in parallel running different firmware versions
causes.ur: Parallel mein lage units par firmware ke version alag hain

causes.en: One unit updated while the others were not
causes.ur: Ek unit update ho gayi, baaki units update nahi hui

solutions.en: Power off all units before checking or updating any firmware.
solutions.ur: Koi bhi firmware check ya update karne se pehle sab units band karein.

solutions.en: Check the firmware version of each unit in the menu and note where they differ.
solutions.ur: Har unit ka menu mein firmware version dekhein aur kahan alag hai yeh note karein.

solutions.en: Update all units to the same firmware version (technician job), then power up and confirm the units run together.
solutions.ur: Sab units ko ek hi firmware version par update karwayein (technician ka kaam), phir power on karke units saath chal rahi hain yeh confirm karein.

source.title: Hybrid 2/3/5/6KW InfiniSolar VII-class manual (ivii_wb — no Tesla badge; Tesla Infinity 6kW Scribd listing)

title.ur: Current share karne mein masla aa gaya

meaning.ur: Current share karne mein masla — parallel/setup setting ka masla.

causes.en: Parallel/setup
causes.ur: Parallel/setup ka masla — setting match nahi kar rahi

causes.en: Parallel cable loose so one unit is not sharing the load
causes.ur: Parallel ki taar dhili hai, ek unit load share nahi kar rahi

causes.en: Units of different capacity or one unit tripped out
causes.ur: Units ki capacity alag hai ya ek unit trip ho gayi hai

solutions.en: Switch off all units and isolate AC supply before checking the parallel cables.
solutions.ur: Parallel cable check karne se pehle sab units band karein aur AC supply alag kar lein.

solutions.en: Check the parallel cable at both ends and meter-check continuity, and confirm all units have the same capacity.
solutions.ur: Parallel cable ke dono kone check karein aur continuity meter se naapein, saath hi sab units ki capacity same hai yeh dekhein.

solutions.en: Retighten or replace the parallel cable and match the capacities, then power up and confirm the load is shared.
solutions.ur: Parallel cable dobara kassi karein ya badlein aur capacity match karein, phir power on karke load share ho raha hai yeh confirm karein.

source.title: Hybrid 2/3/5/6KW InfiniSolar VII-class manual (ivii_wb — no Tesla badge; Tesla Infinity 6kW Scribd listing)

meaning.en: AC output setting different — parallel/setup fault.
meaning.ur: AC output ki setting units mein alag hai — parallel/setup masla.

causes.en: Parallel/setup
causes.ur: Parallel/setup ka masla — setting match nahi kar rahi

causes.en: Output voltage/frequency set differently on the units
causes.ur: Units par output voltage/frequency alag alag set hain

causes.en: One unit changed from the menu without matching the others
causes.ur: Ek unit ki menu se setting badal di gayi, baaki se match nahi ki

solutions.en: Power off the units before changing any menu settings.
solutions.ur: Menu ki koi setting badalne se pehle units band kar dein.

solutions.en: Compare the output voltage and frequency settings on every unit in the menu.
solutions.ur: Menu mein har unit ka output voltage aur frequency setting compare karein.

solutions.en: Make the settings identical on all units and save, then power up and confirm the fault clears.
solutions.ur: Sab units par setting ek jaisi karke save karein, phir power on karke fault khatam hua yeh confirm karein.

source.title: Hybrid 2/3/5/6KW InfiniSolar VII-class manual (ivii_wb — no Tesla badge; Tesla Infinity 6kW Scribd listing)

meaning.ur: CAN bus ka masla — parallel/setup setting ka masla.

causes.en: Parallel/setup
causes.ur: Parallel/setup ka masla — setting match nahi kar rahi

causes.en: Parallel CAN cable loose or not connected at one unit
causes.ur: Parallel ki CAN taar dhili hai ya ek unit par lagi hi nahi

causes.en: CAN wiring damaged or CAN terminating resistor missing
causes.ur: CAN wiring kharab hai ya CAN terminating resistor nahi laga

solutions.en: Switch off all units and isolate supply before checking the CAN wiring.
solutions.ur: CAN wiring check karne se pehle sab units band karein aur supply alag kar lein.

solutions.en: Check the CAN cable at both ends, meter-check continuity and confirm the CAN terminating resistor is fitted.
solutions.ur: CAN cable ke dono kone check karein, continuity meter se naapein aur CAN terminating resistor laga hai yeh dekhein.

solutions.en: Repair or replace the CAN cable or fit the terminating resistor, then power up and confirm communication is restored.
solutions.ur: CAN cable theek ya badlein ya terminating resistor lagayein, phir power on karke communication wapas aa gayi yeh confirm karein.

source.title: Hybrid 2/3/5/6KW InfiniSolar VII-class manual (ivii_wb — no Tesla badge; Tesla Infinity 6kW Scribd listing)

meaning.ur: Host se connection kat gaya — parallel/setup setting ka masla.

causes.en: Parallel/setup
causes.ur: Parallel/setup ka masla — setting match nahi kar rahi

causes.en: Master/host unit switched off or not detected on the bus
causes.ur: Master/host unit band hai ya bus par detect nahi ho rahi

causes.en: Communication wiring between units loose or broken
causes.ur: Units ke darmiyan communication taar dhili ya tooti hui hai

solutions.en: Power off the units before checking the communication wiring.
solutions.ur: Communication wiring check karne se pehle units band kar dein.

solutions.en: Confirm the master host unit is switched on and check the communication wiring between all units.
solutions.ur: Master host unit on hai yeh confirm karein aur sab units ke darmiyan communication wiring check karein.

solutions.en: Repair loose wiring or reset the master, then power up and confirm the other units detect the host again.
solutions.ur: Dhili wiring theek karein ya master reset karein, phir power on karke baaki units host dobara detect kar rahi hain yeh confirm karein.

source.title: Hybrid 2/3/5/6KW InfiniSolar VII-class manual (ivii_wb — no Tesla badge; Tesla Infinity 6kW Scribd listing)

meaning.ur: Synchronization khatam ho gaya — parallel/setup setting ka masla.

causes.en: Parallel/setup
causes.ur: Parallel/setup ka masla — setting match nahi kar rahi

causes.en: Units lost phase synchronization after a power event
causes.ur: Power event ke baad units ka phase sync khatam ho gaya

causes.en: Parallel communication intermittent so sync signal missing
causes.ur: Parallel communication atak rahi hai, sync signal nahi aa raha

solutions.en: Switch off all units and isolate AC supply before further checks.
solutions.ur: Aage check karne se pehle sab units band karein aur AC supply alag kar lein.

solutions.en: Check the parallel communication wiring and confirm every unit is powered and in the same mode.
solutions.ur: Parallel communication wiring check karein aur har unit on hai aur usi mode mein hai yeh confirm karein.

solutions.en: Power up the master first and let the units resynchronize; if the fault returns, repair the communication wiring.
solutions.ur: Pehle master on karein aur units ka dobara sync hone dein; fault wapas aaye to communication wiring repair karwayein.

meaning.en: Battery voltage detected different — parallel/setup fault.
meaning.ur: Battery voltage units mein alag detect hua — yeh parallel/setup ka masla hai.

causes.en: Parallel/setup
causes.ur: Parallel/setup ka masla — setting match nahi kar rahi

causes.en: Parallel units configured for different battery voltages
causes.ur: Parallel mein lage units alag battery voltage par set kiye gaye hain

causes.en: Battery sense wiring loose giving a wrong reading on one unit
causes.ur: Battery sense ki taar dhili hai, ek unit galat reading le raha hai

solutions.en: Switch off the inverter and isolate AC supply before checking the parallel wiring.
solutions.ur: Parallel wiring check karne se pehle inverter band karein aur AC supply alag kar lein.

solutions.en: Open the menu on each unit and check that the battery voltage setting is identical on all of them.
solutions.ur: Har unit ka menu khol kar dekhein ke battery voltage setting sab par bilkul same hai.

solutions.en: Match the settings and tighten the battery sense wiring, then power up all units and confirm the fault clears.
solutions.ur: Setting match karein aur battery sense ki taar kassi kar dein, phir sab units on karke fault khatam hua yeh confirm karein.

title.ur: AC input voltage/frequency units mein alag hai

meaning.en: AC input voltage/frequency detected different — parallel/setup fault.
meaning.ur: AC input voltage/frequency units mein alag hai — parallel/setup masla.

causes.en: Parallel/setup
causes.ur: Parallel/setup ka masla — setting match nahi kar rahi

causes.en: Units fed from different sources or CT settings differ
causes.ur: Units alag sources se feed ho rahi hain ya CT setting alag hai

causes.en: Input sense wiring loose giving different readings
causes.ur: Input sense taar dhili hai, units ko alag alag reading mil rahi hain

solutions.en: Power off all units before checking the input sensing.
solutions.ur: Input sensing check karne se pehle sab units band kar dein.

solutions.en: Measure input voltage and frequency at each unit and check that CT and input sense wiring are the same.
solutions.ur: Har unit par input voltage aur frequency naapein aur CT aur input sense wiring same hai yeh check karein.

solutions.en: Match the input source and CT settings or repair sense wiring, then power up and confirm all units read the same.
solutions.ur: Input source aur CT setting match karein ya sense wiring repair karein, phir power on karke sab units ki reading same hai yeh confirm karein.

meaning.en: AC output current unbalance — parallel/setup fault.
meaning.ur: AC output ka current barabar nahi — parallel/setup ka masla.

causes.en: Parallel/setup
causes.ur: Parallel/setup ka masla — setting match nahi kar rahi

causes.en: Load not shared equally, one unit carrying more current
causes.ur: Load barabar share nahi ho raha, ek unit zyada current le rahi hai

causes.en: Parallel cable or output breaker contact loose on one unit
causes.ur: Parallel taar ya output breaker ka contact ek unit par dhila hai

solutions.en: Switch off the units and isolate AC supply before checking the output wiring.
solutions.ur: Output wiring check karne se pehle units band karein aur AC supply alag kar lein.

solutions.en: Clamp-measure the output current of each unit and check output breaker and parallel cable connections.
solutions.ur: Har unit ka output current clamp se naapein aur output breaker aur parallel cable ke connections check karein.

solutions.en: Tighten loose connections or rebalance the load across the units, then run and confirm the currents are close to equal.
solutions.ur: Dhile connection kassi karein ya load units mein barabar baant dein, phir chala kar currents taqreeban barabar hain yeh confirm karein.

meaning.en: AC output mode setting different — parallel/setup fault.
meaning.ur: AC output mode ki setting units mein alag hai — parallel/setup masla.

causes.en: Parallel/setup
causes.ur: Parallel/setup ka masla — setting match nahi kar rahi

causes.en: AC output mode set differently on the units
causes.ur: Units par AC output mode alag alag set hain

causes.en: Setting changed on one unit without matching the rest
causes.ur: Ek unit ki setting badal di gayi, baaki se match nahi ki gayi

solutions.en: Power off the units before changing the AC output mode.
solutions.ur: AC output mode badalne se pehle units band kar dein.

solutions.en: Compare the AC output mode setting on every unit in the menu.
solutions.ur: Menu mein har unit ka AC output mode setting compare karein.

solutions.en: Set the same output mode on all units and save, then power up and confirm the fault clears.
solutions.ur: Sab units par wahi output mode set karke save karein, phir power on karke fault khatam hua yeh confirm karein.
